summary: Strategy Inc (formerly MicroStrategy) filed an 8-K on October 13, 2026, disclosing under Items 8.01, 7.01 and 9.01 a press release dated October 12, 2026 announcing capital markets and capital management updates, with the release attached as Exhibit 99.1 and incorporated by reference. The filing also reminds investors of the company's website dashboard as a Regulation FD disclosure channel covering securities pricing, bitcoin purchases and holdings, and key performance indicators. No transaction terms, prices, stakes, premiums, board recommendations, or advisors are stated in the excerpt; the registrant acts solely as issuer making a routine disclosure. Watch for Exhibit 99.1 details on bitcoin accumulation or ATM/preferred issuance activity.
